description: The Lone Quasar is a solo team with one backend software engineer. A quasar is a single object that outshines whole galaxies, and that’s the approach here: one person, a focused idea, and a lot of effort. For this challenge, I’m combining my software engineering background with AI-assisted development to turn NASA’s open data into a working, user-friendly app. I’m in it to learn, build something useful, and finish a complete project in one weekend.
